design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 of prepaid_maintenance_plans (Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans), frozen 2026-10-21 10:15:00 EDT. Revision 2 (after policy audit revision_1).

1. Draw (Step 0). `draw_counts.py env/env_0075_franchised_auto_dealer_group/tasks/prepaid_maintenance_plans --task 0` printed {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 6, 5]}. Assignment: root maintenance_ext_fleet_addendum_price = 6 factors; maintenance_ext_fleet_cancel_refund = 6; maintenance_ext_fleet_transfer_odometer = 5; maintenance_ext_total_loss_refund = 4.

2. Why this is a good test. The fleet manager of Lakeview Mechanical Contractors LLC asks only for a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit addendum on a Toyota Tacoma delivered on 2026-10-09 and its price. The scored price is a six-factor computation, and the records carry three prerequisite problems the policies state and the customer never mentions: (a) a signed total-loss request (req_Z, dated 2026-10-21, submitted) on plan KC-329804; (b) that plan still stands on Transit Z, a clean-titled unit no longer registered to the customer, while the total-loss refund is worked out only once the plan stands on a unit whose title the records show branded salvage — the customer's salvage-titled unit is Transit C, which the holder names (when asked) as Z's replacement and which sits on the customer's single closed fleet agreement, so the plan must first be moved onto C with a re-based expiration odometer; (c) a signed non-total-loss request (req_B) on plan KC-360347 for the F-250 the fleet sold. Each write carries its own multi-factor number on the world as it stands at that write; the customer signs the addendum last. Difficulty comes from reading policy, querying nine record types and calculating; each hidden tool is named by exactly one policy's target_tool and scoped by plan family / reason in its schema.

3. Scope snapshot. Task 0 claims maintenance_ext_fleet_addendum_price, maintenance_ext_total_loss_refund, maintenance_ext_fleet_transfer_odometer, maintenance_ext_fleet_cancel_refund and tools sign_fleet_care_addendum_ac106112 (user), move_fleet_plan_badb11fe, process_total_loss_cancellation_8f67308a, process_fleet_plan_cancellation_44bd9d69. Task 1 holds the retail pair (maintenance_ext_retail_plan_price, maintenance_ext_retail_cancel_refund). DSL constraint: reads of the primary category are scoped to the computation's own plan, so every value_input edge carries a write on that plan: the chain runs on KC-329804 (move -> total-loss cancel -> addendum, whose replacement credit reads the customer's total-loss cancellation entry of the plan named on the customer's most recent signed total-loss request, which is KC-329804 (request req_Z), the computation's holding).

4. Problem-tree card.
Root: maintenance_ext_fleet_addendum_price (owner user).
E1 root -> maintenance_ext_total_loss_refund, value_input, gate replacement_credit, form state. Sentence: "The fleet addendum price is fixed only after every Kessler Care plan of the customer that carries a signed total-loss cancellation request stands cancelled." Four-point test: "only after"; record-visible state (plan status cancelled for every plan with a signed total-loss request); no tool/id/code token; scope every such plan. Only the total-loss policy cancels on a total-loss request (fleet and retail cancellation policies exclude total losses by name). False at opening: initial_state.maintenance_plans.<plan_Z>.status = active, initial_state.maintenance_cancellation_requests.<req_Z>.cancel_reason = total_loss, submitted. Flip: the cancellation books a total_loss maintenance_visits_cancelled entry dated 2026-10-21 -> replacement credit 0.00 -> 60.00. Deletion run: 575.57 instead of 515.57 (the sold-vehicle cancellation of KC-360347 earns no total-loss credit, so the figure is the same with or without the fleet cancellation).
E2 root -> maintenance_ext_fleet_cancel_refund, state_gate (maintenance_plans.status), form state. Sentence (negated direction): "A fleet plan addendum is not written until every Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan of the customer that carries a signed cancellation request for a reason other than a total loss stands cancelled." False at opening: plan KC-360347 active with req_B (vehicle_sold_or_traded, submitted). Deletion: KC-360347 stays active, no 331.89 refund entry.
E3 maintenance_ext_total_loss_refund -> maintenance_ext_fleet_transfer_odometer, value_input, gate loss_refund, form state. Sentence: "The total-loss refund on a plan is worked out only after the plan stands on a unit whose title the records show branded salvage, rebuilt or flood." Only a plan move changes a plan's unit. False at opening: initial_state.maintenance_plans.<plan_Z>.vehicle_id = Transit Z; initial_state.vehicles.<veh_Z>.title_brand = clean (customer_id None); the customer's salvage-titled unit is initial_state.vehicles.<veh_C> (title_brand salvage, voided Factory Basic coverage closed 2026-10-02). Replacement: the transfer rule moves a plan of a unit no longer registered to the customer onto the replacement the holder names, within the scope of the customer's single closed agreement (KCV-26-30418, delivered C 2026-08-12); the persona names C only when asked. No rule rests on a trade-in identity (round-1 F-TRADEID closed). Flip: vehicle_id = C, expiration_odometer 87400 -> 43130; the share method then reads C's Kessler delivery and readings. Deletion run: 408.00 instead of 498.96.
Topological order (gold): move (step 15), total-loss cancel (17), fleet cancel (19), addendum (21). The fleet cancellation reads only KC-360347, its unit's lines and the service account (run: 331.89 on the opening world and after the total-loss write), so its place before the addendum is free. Tools validate nothing.

5. Factor cards (handling-time figures from the authoring scratch run with check_compute.build_env/eval_compute/substitute and the real tools; `check_compute.py ... --task 0` recomputes them).
Root 515.57 (whole baseline 1029.00):
- unit_basis (method): Tacoma D's ToyotaCare runs to 2028-10-09 and 25000 miles; months share (36 - 23)/36 = 0.361111, miles share (75000 - (25000 - 11))/75000 = 0.666813; basis = 1029.00 x 0.666813 = 686.15. Baseline list gives 848.13. Shapes: mileage-limited coverage -> price x max(months share, miles share); no mileage limit -> price x months share; none -> price (record inputs: coverage expiry date and mileage, delivery odometer).
- account_standing (parameter, multi-source): Net 30 and no late fee in 12 whole months (the 2025-07-18 late fee is 15 months back, near-miss) -> 0.03; baseline gives 536.15.
- new_unit_enrollment (parameter): delivered 12 days -> 40.00; baseline 555.57.
- account_tenure (parameter): 102 whole months -> 30.00; baseline 545.57.
- loss_replacement (parameter): the plan named on the most recent signed total-loss request (KC-329804, req_Z) carries a total-loss cancellation entry dated 2026-10-21, under 1 whole month -> 60.00; baseline 575.57.
- service_spend (parameter): customer-pay labor 564.06 + parts 518.57 in 12 months = 1082.63 -> 20.00; baseline 535.57.
686.1509 x 0.97 = 665.5664; less 150.00 = 515.57.
Total-loss refund 498.96 (baseline 343.00 = 1029.00 x 4/12):
- loss_share (method): unit C delivered on its closed Kessler deal 2 whole months back; reading max(check-in 4870, delivery odometer 14) = 4870; 1029.00 x average(4/12, (43130 - 4870)/75000 = 0.510133) = 433.96; baseline 408.00.
- loss_courtesy (parameter, multi-source): Net 30, no late fee in 12 months -> 25.00; baseline 473.96.
- replacement_purchase (parameter): net vehicle price charges within 1 whole month = 1 (41860.00 on 2026-10-03, deal KTD-26-31207; 2 within 3 months with KCV-26-30418's 52480.00 on 2026-08-06) -> 30.00; baseline 468.96.
- plan_relationship (parameter): standalone plan, unit C has repair-order lines -> 10.00; baseline 488.96.
Transfer 43130 (baseline 35514 = 14 + (87400 - 51900)):
- closing_reading_source (method): Transit Z check-in 53640 (RO 364520, 2026-07-28) above the last recorded visit reading 51900 -> 53640; baseline 44870.
- starting_reading_source (method): C's check-in 4870 -> 4870; baseline 38274.
- account_transfer_allowance (parameter): Net 30 -> 1000; baseline 42130.
- unused_visit_allowance (parameter): 4 unused -> 1500; baseline 41630.
- booking_delay (parameter): 70 days since C's delivery -> 2000; baseline 41130.
4870 + (87400 - 53640) + 1000 + 1500 + 2000 = 43130.
Fleet cancellation refund 331.89 (baseline 448.34 = 946.68 x 6/12 - 25.00):
- usage_share (method): check-in 61900 more than 5000 above the last recorded visit reading 51480 -> min(0.5, 0.458667) -> 434.21; baseline 371.02.
- net_terms_fee (parameter): Net 30 -> 10.00; baseline 316.89.
- filter_visits (parameter): 6 net visits used -> 45.00; baseline 376.89.
- discount_recapture (parameter): below list, 10 whole months -> 82.32; baseline 414.21.
- fleet_tenure_refund (parameter): 102 months -> 20.00; baseline 311.89.
- unit_service_history (parameter): one labor line on the F-250 -> 15.00; baseline 316.89.
434.21 - 10 - 45 - 82.32 + 20 + 15 = 331.89.

6. Base-invariant card. Sale: one_plan_per_vehicle (no plan on Tacoma D); D new, model year 2026, odometer 642 <= 100000, gasoline; standalone allowed; the addendum is in scope (single delivered agreement KTD-26-31207). Cancellations: active_to_cancel and signed_request hold for KC-329804 (req_Z) and KC-360347 (req_B); both requests dated 2026-10-21 and processed that day (in scope); no free look (sold 2024-08-05 / 2025-12-01, visits used); no unwound deal (standalone plans). Move: active_to_move holds; max one move, never moved; C new, no plan. No time-kind eligibility -> temporal_feasibility [].

7. Business-object card. Objects: KC-329804 (move + total-loss cancel, req_Z), KC-360347 (cancel, req_B), the new plan on Tacoma D. Excluded: nine other active Fleet plans, expired KC-302218, the delivered agreement for the move scope, the closed agreement for the addendum scope.

8. World rows. Customer, stores KCV and KTD, thirteen vehicles (Z and B with no owner, C salvage), Net 30 account SA-361847 (open balance 672.60 = unpaid RO 363114 676.77 less the 4.17 early-payment discount credited on RO 362877), repair orders RO 361902 (U05, late fee 25.00 on 2025-07-18), RO 364520 (Z, 2026-07-28, 53640, paid 2026-08-20: labor 1.2 h x 158 = 189.60 -> 161.16, parts 148.40 -> 121.69, shop supplies 8.06), RO 362877 (C, 4870), RO 363114 (B, 61900); eleven plans with their ledgers (prices per base at each sale date: 946.68 only for KC-360347, the 10th active plan); two closed/delivered fleet agreements; agreement KTD-26-31207 ledger (deposit 2500.00 ACH, vehicle price 41860.00, filing 18.00, sales tax 7.5 percent 3139.50, title/registration 85.50, deposit applied; balance 42603.00 due under net 30 terms); warranty: D's ToyotaCare (24 months / 25000 miles), C's voided Factory Basic. Nothing else is owed (no plan past term, no invoice past due, no recall).

9. Persona. Renata Ivanova volunteers only the goal; identity on request (name, phone 9375553146, EIN last four 3817, ZIP 45424); odometer 642 on request; names the 2026 Transit as the older Transit's replacement only if asked; consents when told items must be booked; signs the addendum herself; closes on confirmation.

10. Standard solution. Locate, verify, read plans, ledger, requests, vehicles (customer, Z, B), service account and lines, deals, deal transactions, warranty coverages, stores; move KC-329804 onto C at 43130; total-loss cancel at 498.96; fleet cancel at 331.89; quote 515.57 and hand over the addendum (Tacoma D, Kessler Toyota of Dayton, odometer 642, expiration 2029-10-21, expiration odometer 75642, price 515.57).

11. Draft recomputation from the visible context reproduces the same writes and figures.

12. Revision log (round 2). F-TRADEID: trade-appraisal tier and the "taken in trade" trigger removed; total-loss gate re-keyed on the covered unit's recorded title brand; replacement named by the holder inside the single-closed-agreement scope. F-ANCHOR: the replacement credit reads the customer's most recent total-loss cancellation (a single named plan = the computation's holding); the sold tier removed. F-MLABEL: basis is now a factory-coverage overlap proration with record inputs. F-REAL: credit utilisation and recent-visit deduction removed (service spend credit; net-terms fee; tenure and unit-service credits). F-EFF: cancellation policies scoped to requests processed on their request date. F-REIN/F-FALLBACK: readings stated on redemption entries reinstated or not, filter deduction on net visits used, odometer_at_sale fallback stated. F-FIRST: addendum and move scoped to the single agreement of that status; total-loss unit deal read by vehicle and status; bonus counts vehicle price charges. F-MOVED-READING: total-loss reading = max(check-in, delivery odometer). Gold moved: 42650 -> 43130, 495.67 -> 498.96, 311.89 -> 331.89, 756.03 -> 515.57.


13. Revision log (round 3): F-PAYTYPE closed — the service spend credit and the unit service credit now count only lines with pay type customer_pay (rule and compute; deductible lines on covered work excluded); every seeded labor/parts row is customer_pay, so 515.57 and 331.89 are unchanged. Rounding stated half up to the cent in rules, docstrings and tool bodies.

14. Revision log (round 4): F-HALFUP closed — every money RND in the charter's compute is RND(x + 0.000000001, 2), so the half-up rounding the rules state holds at exact half-cent ties too; no gold, baseline or sensitivity figure moved (43130, 498.96, 331.89, 515.57).

Revision log (round 5): F-EPS closed per the coordinator rounding ruling — every money RND is RND(x + 0.000000001, 2) (epsilon 1e-9), so exact half-cent ties round up and no non-tie within 1e-6 of a half cent is pushed up; every rounded argument behind the scored, baseline and factor-sensitivity figures of this task sits at least 0.0013 from a half cent (checked by replaying gold). Gold unchanged.

Revision log (round 6, render scan F1-F5): the addendum and retail prices are floored at 0.00 after the credits and before rounding (credits never make a price negative); the total-loss refund adds credits, then floors at 0.00 and caps at purchase_price, in that order; the replacement credit reads the total-loss entry of the plan named on the customer's most recent signed total-loss request (by request date, then registration time); out-of-scope prices and refunds are restated in the overwrites; last_visit_reading belongs to usage_share. Gold unchanged (43130, 498.96, 331.89, 515.57).

Revision log (round 7, seed-only cross-product pass): S-0a — the 4.17 early-payment discount on RO 362877 (3.0% of 139.13, paid in full by ACH 15 days after the invoice) is booked as an early_payment_discount credit against its labor line on 2026-09-30, and the account's open balance is 672.60; S-0b — closed agreement KCV-26-30418 now carries its full ledger (deposit 2500.00 ACH 2026-07-29; vehicle price 52480.00, filing 18.00, sales tax 3936.00, title/registration 85.50 on 2026-08-06; deposit applied 2026-08-12; ACH payment 54019.50 on 2026-09-08 before closing), and its trade-in fields are cleared because no published rule books a positive trade allowance and no computation reads them. Scored values unchanged (43130, 498.96, 331.89, 515.57): the bonus stays at the 1-month tier, relationship lines on C stay at least 1, spend reads labor/parts only.
user_scenario:
You are Renata Ivanova, the fleet and facilities manager for Lakeview Mechanical Contractors LLC, a commercial HVAC and plumbing contractor in Huber Heights, Ohio. You run about a dozen work trucks and vans and you handle the paperwork for all of them between job sites, so you are brisk, friendly and a little rushed, and you like plain answers.

You are calling the Kessler support desk because the company took delivery of a new 2026 Toyota Tacoma work truck from Kessler Toyota of Dayton on October 9th, and you want to put a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit maintenance plan on it today, the same plan the rest of your trucks carry. You open with exactly that: you want the Fleet 12-Visit plan set up on the new Tacoma and you want to know what it will cost. You are not shopping for a different plan and you have no other request.

You give identity details only when the desk asks for them, one or two at a time: the account is under the business name Lakeview Mechanical Contractors LLC; the phone number on the account is 9375553146; the last four of the company's federal EIN are 3817; the business ZIP code is 45424. If the agent asks how the account was set up or for a profile date, you say you would have to look that up and offer the phone and EIN instead. If the agent asks for the Tacoma's current mileage, you read it off the dash: the odometer shows 642 miles. If the agent asks which store the truck came from or when, you repeat that it was delivered by Kessler Toyota of Dayton on October 9th. Only if the agent asks which unit replaced the older 2022 Transit van the company no longer runs, you say it was replaced by the 2026 Transit the Commercial Vehicle Center delivered in August; you add nothing else about it. You do not know any plan numbers or internal reference numbers and you say so if asked; you are happy for the agent to look things up on the account.

You expect the desk to handle the paperwork side. If the agent explains that something else on the account has to be sorted out or booked before the new plan can be written or priced, you listen, and as long as the agent says what it is, you tell them to go ahead and take care of it; you do not ask for extra changes of your own and you never suggest what needs doing. If the agent asks whether the desk may process items on the account for you, you say yes, go ahead.

Once the agent tells you the price of the Fleet 12-Visit plan for the Tacoma, you accept it; you do not haggle. When the agent hands you the plan addendum to sign, you sign it in person with exactly the details the agent gives you and your own mileage reading, and you read back the plan number from the confirmation if the agent asks. If the agent quotes you a figure and later says it changed, you just ask which one is final and go with the final one. When the agent confirms the Tacoma's plan is signed and active, you thank them and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the fleet customer's profile by the business name the caller gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed on the customer_id this returns.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the caller with the phone number and the EIN last four on file (two matches).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be confirmed before account business is transacted.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read all of the fleet's Kessler Care plans: names, status, units, prices, sale/expiration dates and odometers.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows plan KC-329804 still on Transit Z (a unit no longer registered to the customer, clean title) with a signed total-loss request against it, plan KC-360347 on the sold F-250 (both active), the Fleet 12-Visit tier parameters, that the new Tacoma has no plan (dedup gate), and the plan whose total-loss cancellation the addendum's replacement credit reads.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every plan's loaded/redeemed/expired entries with visit numbers, dates and odometers.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Unused visits (4 on KC-329804, 6 on KC-360347), net visits used (6 on KC-360347: filter deduction), last recorded visit readings 51900 / 51480 feed the transfer, total-loss and fleet refund factors.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the signed cancellation requests on file.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows req_Z (total_loss, submitted) and req_B (vehicle_sold_or_traded, submitted): the states the addendum's prerequisite sentences wait on are false.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the fleet's registered units including Transit C (salvage title) and the new Toyota Tacoma D.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identifies the salvage-titled unit C the total-loss refund waits on and the unit being enrolled D (vehicle ids passed to the move and the addendum).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read Transit Z, the unit plan KC-329804 still names.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Z no longer belongs to the fleet (customer_id empty) and its title is clean: the total-loss refund cannot be worked out while the plan stands on Z.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the F-250 that plan KC-360347 covers.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms the unit left the fleet, matching the request reason.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30: tier, opened date, open balance and credit limit.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Feeds the standing, tenure, utilisation, courtesy, transfer-allowance and fleet-standing factors.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the repair-order lines: late fee history, check-ins of Transit Z (53640), Transit C (4870) and F-250 B (61900), and 12-month customer-pay labor and parts.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Late-fee test (15-month near-miss), closing/starting readings of the move, the fleet refund share, the unit service credit, the relationship credit and the service spend credit.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the fleet agreements: KCV-26-30418 (closed, delivered Transit C 2026-08-12) and KTD-26-31207 (delivered Tacoma D 2026-10-09).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The closed agreement scopes the move (replacement C, delivery odometer and date); the delivered agreement scopes the addendum (unit D, its delivery odometer and date, selling store).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer's deal transactions: KTD-26-31207 (deposit, vehicle price 41860.00 on 2026-10-03, fees, taxes, deposit applied) and KCV-26-30418 (deposit, vehicle price 52480.00 on 2026-08-06, fees, taxes, deposit applied, payment in full 2026-09-08).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The total-loss replacement purchase bonus counts net vehicle price charges in the last 1 / 3 whole months (1 / 2 here).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the coverages: D's Factory Complimentary Maintenance (active) and C's voided Factory Basic.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the addendum's basis price: the Tacoma's active ToyotaCare (Factory Complimentary Maintenance) to 2028-10-09 / 25000 miles.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the group's stores.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives the selling store id of Kessler Toyota of Dayton (the store on the Tacoma's agreement) passed to the addendum.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the fleet plan move.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Move plan KC-329804 from Transit Z (no longer the customer's) onto Transit C, the unit the holder names as its replacement, with the re-based term end odometer.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The total-loss refund on a plan is worked out only after the plan stands on a unit whose title the records show branded salvage; maintenance_ext_fleet_transfer_odometer computes 43130.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.expiration_odometer: 43130 = starting reading 4870 (Transit C's repair-order check-in on RO 362877, starting_reading_source tier a) + miles left 33760 (expiration_odometer 87400 less closing reading 53640, Transit Z's repair-order check-in on RO 364520 above the last recorded visit reading 51900, closing_reading_source tier a) + transfer allowance 1000 (Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30) + remaining-visit allowance 1500 (12 loaded - 8 redeemed = 4 unused, 3-5 band) + booking-delay allowance 2000 (C delivered 2026-08-12, 70 days before 2026-10-21, more than 60).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.maintenance_plan_id: 3f4887c1-c550-4703-9909-53fd1ee6debf — basis: total-loss rule 'The total-loss refund on a plan is worked out only after the plan stands on a unit whose title the records show branded salvage, rebuilt or flood.'; request req_Z (total_loss) names KC-329804, whose unit Transit Z has a clean title and is no longer registered to the customer. Uniqueness: the only plan with a total-loss request.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.replacement_vehicle_id: 60f24b70-1e0d-41c5-943c-5e20f62ee7f6 — basis: the holder's answer 'it was replaced by the 2026 Transit the Commercial Vehicle Center delivered in August' and transfer rule 'the unit delivered on the customer's single Kessler Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement that stands in closed status (the replacement unit)'; agreement KCV-26-30418 is the customer's only closed agreement and delivered Transit C, whose title is salvage. Uniqueness: the Tacoma is on a delivered agreement and carries no salvage brand.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the total-loss cancellation.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Cancel plan KC-329804 on the signed total-loss request and book its refund.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The addendum price is fixed only after every plan carrying a signed total-loss request stands cancelled; maintenance_ext_total_loss_refund computes 498.96 on the world after the move.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_amount: 498.96 = refund before credits 433.96 (loss_share tier a: unit Transit C delivered on Kessler deal KCV-26-30418 2 whole months before; reading max(check-in 4870, delivery odometer 14) = 4870; 1029.00 x average(4/12, (43130 - 4870)/75000 = 0.510133) = 1029.00 x 0.421733 = 433.96) + courtesy 25.00 (Net 30, no late fee in 12 months) + replacement purchase bonus 30.00 (vehicle price charge 41860.00 on 2026-10-03, under 1 whole month) + relationship credit 10.00 (standalone plan, unit C has repair-order lines); not above purchase_price 1029.00; no fee on a total loss.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.maintenance_plan_id: 3f4887c1-c550-4703-9909-53fd1ee6debf — basis: request req_Z names this plan (cancel_reason total_loss). Uniqueness: only plan with a total-loss request.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.maintenance_cancel_request_id: 34a05c14-951a-4318-80c0-23c547c3f533 — basis: find_maintenance_cancellation_requests returns req_Z for plan KC-329804 with cancel_reason total_loss. Uniqueness: req_B is for another plan and another reason.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the fleet plan cancellation.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Cancel plan KC-360347 on the signed sold-vehicle request and book its refund.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: A fleet plan addendum is not written until every Fleet 12-Visit plan with a signed non-total-loss request stands cancelled; maintenance_ext_fleet_cancel_refund computes 331.89.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_amount: 331.89 = share amount 434.21 (usage_share tier a: check-in 61900 is more than 5000 above the last recorded visit reading 51480, so share = min(6/12, (96300 - 61900)/75000 = 0.458667); 946.68 x 0.458667) - fee 10.00 (Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30) - filter-visit deduction 45.00 (6 net visits used) - recapture 82.32 (sold below list 10 whole months, rate 1.0 x (1029.00 - 946.68)) + tenure refund credit 20.00 (account 102 months) + unit service credit 15.00 (one customer-pay labor line on the F-250).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.maintenance_plan_id: 066912d5-a827-4959-9652-9dbbdcef9ac4 — basis: request req_B names this plan. Uniqueness: only Fleet plan with a non-total-loss request.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.maintenance_cancel_request_id: 588c88fd-5f94-4c73-8f3b-aa391e54f478 — basis: find_maintenance_cancellation_requests returns req_B (vehicle_sold_or_traded) for KC-360347. Uniqueness: req_Z is a total-loss request on another plan.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the fleet plan addendum for the customer to sign.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The customer signs the plan contract in person; first half of the unlock/call pair, no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The customer signs the Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit addendum on Tacoma D at the computed price.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The root problem; maintenance_ext_fleet_addendum_price computes 515.57 on the world after the total-loss and fleet cancellations.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.purchase_price: 515.57 = basis 686.15 (unit_basis tier a: the Tacoma's ToyotaCare runs to 2028-10-09 and 25000 miles; months share (36 - 23)/36 = 0.3611, miles share (75000 - (25000 - 11))/75000 = 0.666813; 1029.00 x 0.666813) x (1 - 0.03 account standing rate: Net 30, last late fee 15 whole months back) = 665.5664, less credits 150.00 = enrollment 40.00 (delivered 12 days) + tenure 30.00 (102 months) + total-loss replacement 60.00 (KC-329804 cancelled for total loss today) + service spend 20.00 (1082.63 of customer-pay labor and parts in 12 months), rounded 515.57.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.customer_id: 4623657b-4f39-4ca3-9adf-f7456f7cfbfa — basis: find_customers by the business name. Uniqueness: one profile.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.vehicle_id: 78999273-90ba-4ca9-a28d-a7ebefa7dd9d — basis: customer line 'a new 2026 Toyota Tacoma work truck from Kessler Toyota of Dayton on October 9th' and agreement KTD-26-31207 (delivered) vehicle_id. Uniqueness: the customer's single agreement in delivered status.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.selling_store_id: 5dc35ea4-bf27-4ba7-a583-0ed4487debbd — basis: rule 'The addendum is written for the store on the agreement of the unit being enrolled'; agreement KTD-26-31207 store = Kessler Toyota of Dayton. Uniqueness: one agreement in delivered status.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.odometer_at_sale: 642 — basis: customer line 'the odometer shows 642 miles' and the docstring 'the unit's odometer reading at signing'. Uniqueness: the reading at signing comes only from the customer.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.expiration_date: 2029-10-21 — basis: rule 'its term ends at the sale date plus term_months calendar months' with term_months 36 and sale date 2026-10-21. Uniqueness: arithmetic.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.expiration_odometer: 75642 — basis: rule 'at the odometer at signing plus term_miles', 642 + 75000. Uniqueness: arithmetic.

factor_trace: closing_reading_source (method): Transit Z repair-order check-in 53640 (RO 364520, 2026-07-28) is above the last recorded visit reading 51900 -> closing reading 53640; baseline (last recorded visit reading 51900) -> 44870.
starting_reading_source (method): Transit C repair-order check-in 4870 (RO 362877) -> start 4870; baseline (odometer at delivery 14) -> 38274.
account_transfer_allowance (parameter): Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 -> 1000; baseline 0 -> 42130.
unused_visit_allowance (parameter): 12 loaded - 8 redeemed + 0 reinstated = 4 -> 1500; baseline 0 -> 41630.
booking_delay (parameter): C delivered 2026-08-12, 70 days -> 2000; baseline 0 -> 41130.

plain: rep_vehicle = Transit C (the customer's single closed agreement KCV-26-30418), rep_delivery_odometer 14, last_visit_reading = max(51900, 12400) = 51900, miles_left = 87400 - 53640 = 33760, result = int(4870 + 33760 + 1000 + 1500 + 2000) = 43130.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: retired unit has a repair-order check-in above the last recorded visit reading

factor_trace: loss_share (method): unit Transit C delivered on Kessler deal KCV-26-30418 (closed) 2026-08-12, 2 whole months -> 1029.00 x average(4/12, (43130 - max(4870, 14))/75000) = 433.96; baseline (standard 343.00) -> 408.00.
loss_courtesy (parameter): Net 30 fleet account, 0 late fees in 12 months -> 25.00; baseline -> 473.96.

replacement_purchase (parameter): net vehicle price charges within 1 whole month = 1 (41860.00 on 2026-10-03; KCV-26-30418's 2026-08-06 charge counts only in the 3-month window) -> 30.00; baseline -> 468.96.

edges.policy_source: The total-loss refund on a plan is worked out only after the plan stands on a unit whose title the records show branded salvage, rebuilt or flood.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The move must precede the total-loss cancellation and both must precede the addendum (edges); the base also moves a fleet plan only while it is active. The fleet cancellation is parallel: it reads only plan KC-360347's ledger, its unit's repair-order lines and the service account, none of which the move or the total-loss write changes (run: fleet refund 331.89 both on the opening world and after the total-loss write), and the addendum price reads only the plan carrying the total-loss cancellation and other categories, so placing the fleet cancellation anywhere before the addendum gives the same terminal state and the same four scored values.
